All aboard · since 1998

Dine in First Class

In 1998 a 1955 CIE locomotive made its final journey from Dublin to Castlerea. It never ran again — restored instead, and given a permanent home at the heart of the house.

Hell's Kitchen remains the only bar in Ireland with a full-size train inside it. Beneath a ceiling of framed railway history, the carriage booths are the finest tables we set.
